response.justification: Bogdan brings deep, long-tenured hands-on engineering experience across web, embedded, and distributed systems, a genuine open-source track record (GISCollective, D-lang libraries, FOSS4G talk), Linux/DevOps familiarity, and a CS degree — all relevant to the technical side of the role. However, the position is an executive-level leadership post requiring formal team leadership, IT architecture and technical project management ownership, UML-based modeling, requirements management, and security/compliance advisory, none of which are evidenced in the resume beyond founder-level solo work and mentoring/workshops. The decisive blocker is language: the role mandates German at C1 minimum and the candidate lists German as 'Basic', which is disqualifying for a client-facing consulting lead in a German market.
strengths: 15+ years broad, polyglot engineering across full stack, embedded, and high-throughput systems
Authentic open-source and Linux credentials, including founding and running an OSS geo-data platform
Proven knowledge-sharing ability via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' vs. required C1 for client-facing leadership
No formal team leadership, line management, or technical project management experience
No evidence of UML modeling, requirements management, or IT security/compliance work

key_factors.factor: Lack of leadership and architecture/project-management track record
Strong senior engineering depth and open-source/Linux background
